messages:
Aisha: hey team — heads up, my flight just got delayed, might miss the 23:30 handoff. I have the pager for the 23:00-07:00 window. Can someone shadow or take primary if I can’t make it? I’m happy to do a quick run-through now.
Ben: @Aisha sorry to hear that. I can cover primary from 23:00–02:00 if needed. can you share any active watchlists or recent alerts? :thumbsup:
Aisha: thanks @Ben. nothing currently firing but we had a small latency blip on embeds earlier; linked traces in the console. runbook is here: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/oncall/primary-handoff — the key bits are the pager escalation matrix and the warm-shadow steps.
Carlos: tagging telemetry — if you hand off, check /dashboards/latency/embeds and the token-rate chart. quick grep for error spikes: `kubectl logs -lapp=embed-worker --since=1h | grep -i "error\|timeout"`
incident-bot: IncidentBot: Reminder — when handing off primary please run `oncall handoff` to populate the channel and ping the following: @primary, @secondary, and @oncall-sre. See https://redwood.internal/tools/oncall for CLI docs.
Ben: copying the checklist here so it’s easy during swap:
```
Handoff checklist:
1) Confirm pager routing (pagerduty -> primary) `pd validate-svc --service inference` 
2) Share active incidents list (`oncall incidents list`) 
3) Post runbook links and short summary in channel
4) Confirm telemetry dashboards are accessible
5) Shadow actively for 15m if possible
```
Dana: I can be secondary for the window, and step to primary if @Ben needs to drop early. @Aisha can you @mention any customer impact items in the handoff note? helps the CS folks.
Aisha: yep — only one user-facing impact earlier: a ~500ms embed latency spike for a small cohort (eu-west). No errors surfaced to SLOs, but putting it in the handoff note.
Ben: noted. one more ops pointer: if the pager triggers for model-serving OOMs, follow runbook section "OOM mitigation": restart pod gcloud zone -> `kubectl delete pod -ljob=serve--quant` and watch warm startups. That usually fixes transient OOMs.
Carlos: also ctrl-plane alarm: if `kv-cache-miss-rate` > 0.2 for 5m, enable prefix cache on the route: `redwood route update --cache-prefix true --route-id r-xxxx` and ping infra.
deploy-bot: DeployBot: deploy started for model/optimizer v2 -> canary targets: embeds-east-1 (tracking CI-9821). ETA ~12m. If you’re primary, be aware of extra churn.
Ben: thanks @deploy-bot — given that, I’ll shadow with @Dana active in the channel and take primary at 23:00. @Aisha if you can DM me your runbook highlight notes (keys + user impact bullet) I’ll paste them when I take the handoff.
Aisha: sending short DM now. also leaving a small snippet to paste in channel during handoff: "No active incidents. Prior event: embeds latency spike (~500ms, eu-west) — no SLO breach. Watch canary deploy for 15m post-rollout."
Dana: copying that. I’ll keep an eye on pagers and telemetry; @Carlos if something looks odd I’ll escalate to infra.
Ben: ok, plan set. I’ll post the formal handoff at 22:55 and include runbook links + the short impact note. everyone reachable here. :raised_hands:
Aisha: thanks team, really appreciate it — will update if plans change.
